title: 第25章 碧空灵蚕郡中六曹第26章 仙族之威反制县令
slug: 家族修仙我以子嗣登仙
content_zh:
“这是碧空灵蚕——！
！”
陈二伯看着被陈景安用小罐子盖住的青色小蚕，顿时有点怀疑人生了。
不是，你小子凭什么的！
有句俗话是，舍不着孩子套不着狼！
陈景安不仅抓到了这价值连城的“碧空灵蚕”
，甚至他的聚灵阵也没丢。
陈二伯觉得自己真的要犯红眼病了！
陈景安看着二伯这模样，顿时庆幸自己没有用“叶蚯”
在他面前骑脸输出。
他一脸无辜问道：“不知这碧空灵蚕能卖多少灵石。”
“至少五十块。”
陈二伯咽了一口唾沫，伸出一个巴掌：“而且，这还是有价无市的，因为一般人得了这样的好东西也不会拿去卖。”
“碧空灵蚕，可以持续产出一种名为‘碧空蚕丝’的珍贵材料，此物具有极强的韧性，强度不弱于法器。
如果碧空蚕丝足够多，甚至可以困住练气九层。”
练气九层都能困住！
陈景安听到这里，眼睛都直了，连忙道：“不卖了，不卖了。”
开什么玩笑！
这要是留着自己攒蚕丝，将来等实力足够了，就用这蚕丝去套别人麻袋。
绝对一套一个准！

要把这五十块灵石给赚回来，那还不是分分钟的事情？
陈二伯的嘴翘得老高，心里也替陈景安高兴，但这不影响他给侄儿滋马尿。
“你可别傻乎乎全信了这话。”
“如果遇到的练气九层是拥有上品法器的，对方是有能力将这蚕丝给破开的。”
陈景安眉头一挑，目光瞟了瞟二伯，意有所指：“套不了练气九层，用来套练气七层也是可以的。”
“你这小子。”
陈二伯算是被他弄得没脾气了，起身从背后的墙面上摘下一本小册子，直接甩到陈景安脸上。
“有关这灵蚕的具体信息都在这书上了，你自己看去。”
“现在带上书，滚蛋！”
“遵命。”
……
陈景安屁颠屁颠离开，一整晚都在研究这本小册子，然后根据上面的信息，逐渐完善自己对这条碧空灵蚕的了解。
这碧空灵蚕是杂食性的灵虫，需要喂养灵物。
在正常情况下，每年可以吐出“碧空蚕丝”
一两，作价十块灵石。
碧空灵蚕的寿命通常在六到七年。
陈景安手里的这头，从体型来看，应该还不到一岁的样子。
content_en:
"This is the Blue Sky Spirit Silkworm——!
! "
Uncle Chen looked at the little green silkworm covered by Chen Jing'an in a small jar, and he suddenly became a little doubtful about life.
No, why do you think so?
There is a saying that if you can’t let go of your children, you can’t catch the wolf!
Chen Jingan not only caught this priceless "Blue Sky Spirit Silkworm"
, even his Spirit Gathering Formation was not lost.
Erbo Chen felt that he was really going to have pink eye!
Chen Jing'an looked at his second uncle's appearance and was immediately glad that he didn't use "Ye Earthworm"
Face output in front of him.
He asked with an innocent face: "I wonder how many spiritual stones this Blue Sky Spiritual Silkworm can sell for."
"At least fifty dollars."
Erbo Chen swallowed his saliva and stretched out his hand: "Besides, this is priceless, because most people won't sell such good things if they get them."
"The Blue Sky Silkworm can continuously produce a precious material called 'Blue Sky Silk'. This material has extremely strong toughness and is no weaker than a magical weapon.
If there are enough blue sky silks, they can even trap the ninth level of Qi training. "
Even the ninth level of Qi training can trap him!
Chen Jingan's eyes widened when he heard this, and he quickly said: "I won't sell it anymore, I won't sell it anymore."
What a joke!
If you save the silk for yourself, when you are strong enough in the future, you can use the silk to cover other people's sacks.
Absolutely the exact set!
To earn back these fifty spiritual stones, wouldn’t it only take a matter of minutes?
Uncle Chen's mouth was raised, and he was happy for Chen Jing'an in his heart, but this did not affect him from peeing on his nephew.
"Don't be so stupid as to believe this."
"If you encounter someone at the ninth level of Qi training who has a high-grade magic weapon, the opponent will be able to break through the silk."
Chen Jing'an raised his eyebrows, glanced at his second uncle, and pointed out: "It can't be used to train the ninth level of Qi training, but it can be used to train the seventh level of Qi training."
"You kid."
Uncle Chen lost his temper. He stood up and picked off a pamphlet from the wall behind him and threw it directly in Chen Jing'an's face.
"The specific information about this spiritual silkworm is in this book. Read it yourself."
"Now take the book and get out!"
"As commanded."
…
Chen Jingan left in a hurry and spent the whole night studying this booklet, and based on the information above, he gradually improved his understanding of this blue sky spiritual silkworm.
This blue sky spiritual silkworm is an omnivorous spiritual insect and needs to be fed by spiritual creatures.
Under normal circumstances, "blue sky silk" can be spit out every year
One tael, priced at ten spiritual stones.
The lifespan of a Blue Sky Spirit Silkworm is usually six to seven years.
Judging from its size, the one in Chen Jingan's hand should be less than a year old.
